decision_conditions: The single storey rear extension by reason of its combined depth and height would have an overbearing effect upon the adjoining property No. 44 The Mall that would result in a sense of enclosure, loss of light, and loss of outlook, detrimental to the amenities of that adjoining neighbouring property. The proposal is therefore contrary to London Plan (2021) Policies D3, Core Strategy (2010) Policies CP30, Development Management Document (2014) Polices DMD8, DMD11 and DMD37 and National Planning Policy Framework (2024).

The proposed part two-storey aspect of the rear extension, by reason of its siting, design and depth, would have an overbearing effect upon the adjoining property No. 44 The Mall that would result in a sense of enclosure and loss of outlook, detrimental to the amenities of that adjoining neighbouring property, contrary to London Plan (2021) Policies D3, Core Strategy (2010) Policies CP30, Development Management Document (2014) Polices DMD8, DMD11 and DMD37 and National Planning Policy Framework (2024).

The proposed part two-storey aspect of the rear extension, by reason of its design, form, and siting, would appear visually intrusive, incongruous, overly dominant and would unbalance the pair of semi-detached properties, and would represent significant overdevelopment of the host building detracting from its character and appearance, whilst also impacting negatively on the character and appearance of the surrounding area. The proposal would be contrary to the NPPF (2024), D3 of the London Plan (2021), DMD8, DMD11 and DMD37 of the Development Management Plan (2014) and CP30 of the Core Strategy (2010).
description: Part single, part 2-storey rear extension with green roof and extension to existing basement.
